test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Confiscated
solution:
The correct answer is: **Seized**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Confiscated **means to take something away from someone, usually as a penalty or punishment.
 
• **Seized** means to take hold of something forcibly or suddenly, which is the closest synonym to confiscated.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **seized**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Marinated** means to soak food in a seasoned liquid before cooking it.
 
• **Acquitted** means to be declared not guilty of a crime.
 
• **Liberated** means to set someone free from imprisonment, slavery, or oppression.
